name: Temasek
coverage: Publicly disclosed Temasek India holdings, strategic investments and current portfolio evidence. Percentages are shown only where a source states them; indirect holdings and consortium stakes remain clearly labelled.
limitations: Temasek does not publish a complete India beneficial-ownership register. Private-company percentages may be undisclosed or reported by the press.
Portfolio-page percentages can be dated and may represent a group or investment vehicle rather than the entire Temasek exposure.
Reported strategy and proposed transactions are not treated as completed investments.

companies.name: Haldiram's
companies.relationship: Minority investment in the family-owned snacks and foods business.
companies.summary: Temasek took a sizeable minority position in one of India's best-known packaged-food brands, giving it exposure to branded consumption and distribution expansion.
companies.thesis: A trusted domestic brand with scale, export potential and room to formalise a fragmented snacks market.
companies.risks: Valuation, family-business governance, food inflation and execution across a wide product portfolio.

companies.name: Manipal Health Enterprises
companies.relationship: Long-term strategic investor; Temasek's portfolio page shows a majority interest at the reported group level.
companies.summary: Manipal is a core healthcare platform serving a growing need for organised tertiary care; the disclosed percentage is a portfolio-page figure and should not be read as a fresh 2026 purchase.
companies.thesis: Hospital capacity, clinical quality and professionalisation can compound with India's rising healthcare spend.
companies.risks: High capital intensity, clinician retention, regulation and integration of acquired hospitals.

companies.name: ICICI Bank
companies.relationship: Public-market portfolio holding shown on Temasek's portfolio page.
companies.summary: A large, well-capitalised private bank provides exposure to formal credit growth and digital financial services.
companies.thesis: Scale, improving asset quality and a strong digital franchise can support long-duration compounding.
companies.risks: Credit-cycle losses, valuation and macroeconomic pressure on lending growth.

companies.name: Adani Airport Holdings
companies.relationship: Investor in a multi-party primary equity round; Temasek's individual stake was not disclosed.
companies.summary: The airport platform announced a large primary equity raise with Temasek among the named investors. The proceeds target airport capacity and airport-city development.
companies.thesis: Passenger growth and non-aeronautical revenues can create a long runway for a scaled airport platform.
companies.risks: Execution, leverage, regulatory approvals, concentration and the fact that Temasek's individual allocation is undisclosed.

companies.name: Schneider Electric India
companies.relationship: India exposure referenced in Temasek's portfolio review; exact current legal holding not presented here.
companies.summary: A strategic industrial exposure aligned with India's electrification, automation and infrastructure build-out.
companies.thesis: Energy management and automation benefit from manufacturing, data-centre and grid investment.
companies.risks: Industrial cyclicality, project timing and global parent-company structure.

report.title: Temasek in India
report.summary: Temasek combines long-horizon public and private investing with a preference for sectors where India's rising incomes, formalisation and infrastructure needs can create durable platforms. Its recent signals point to consumer brands, healthcare, financial services and infrastructure, while exact holdings and individual allocations are often private.

sections.title: Investment idea
sections.text: Temasek's India approach is platform-oriented: back businesses with trusted brands or essential infrastructure, then support professionalisation and scale. It has publicly described digitalisation, green transition and healthcare as priority opportunity areas and has said it is looking for more family-run businesses willing to partner with institutional capital.

sections.title: What the evidence says
sections.text: Haldiram's is the clearest recent direct consumer example. Manipal Health and ICICI Bank illustrate the healthcare and financial-services exposure visible in Temasek's portfolio material. The Adani Airports round shows continuing interest in infrastructure, but the investor group structure means the individual Temasek commitment is not measurable from the public report.

sections.title: How to read the portfolio
sections.text: The public evidence supports a long-term quality-and-platform interpretation, not a short-term trading signal. Ownership percentages should be treated as dated disclosures, and private-company values should not be compared directly with listed-market holdings.

themes.name: Branded consumption
themes.case: Haldiram's reflects the appeal of trusted Indian brands with national distribution and export optionality.
themes.watch: Pricing power, distribution productivity and governance.

themes.name: Healthcare delivery
themes.case: Temasek's Manipal exposure aligns with long-term demand for organised tertiary care.
themes.watch: Capacity additions, clinical quality and returns on new hospitals.

themes.name: Infrastructure and energy transition
themes.case: Airports and energy-management platforms fit India's physical and digital infrastructure build-out.
themes.watch: Debt, approvals, project execution and disclosed ownership routes.
